items.title_zh: 美国各地再次发现长有“触手”的“弗兰肯斯坦”兔子
items.title_en: 'Frankenstein' rabbits with 'tentacles' spotted across US again
items.summary_zh: 你有没有见过一只毛茸茸的兔子，因为它奇特的外表而差点吐出来？今天可能就是这一天，当地人报告说他们再次看到了怪异的“弗兰肯斯坦”兔子。威斯康星州、明尼苏达州和纽约等地区的美国人越来越多地遇到这种奇怪的生物，这些兔子的脸上和头上都长着黑色的触手。大约一年前，科罗拉多州柯林斯堡因兔子涌入而震惊，导致科罗拉多州
items.summary_en: Ever looked at a fluffy bunny and nearly vomited due to its grotesque appearance? Today might be that day as locals report seeing freaky ‘Frankenstein’ rabbits once again. Americans across areas like Wisconsin , Minnesota and New York have increasingly been encountering the strange creatures, which sees bunnies sporting black tentacles on their faces and heads. This comes almost one year after Fort Collins, Colorado, was rocked by an influx of the rabbits, leading to Colorado Parks and Wildlife to issue a warning…

items.title_zh: 科学家认为宇宙终结的五种方式
items.title_en: Five ways scientists think the universe could meet its end
items.summary_zh: 对于宇宙将如何终结，科学家们有五种可能性。宇宙的终结可能不是我们有生之年必须考虑的事情，我当然指的是人类的生命，至少你会希望如此。但这并没有阻止科学界尝试提出大量理论来解释在极其遥远的未来事情可能如何发展。我们大多数人都听说过大爆炸，宇宙爆发的那一刻
items.summary_en: Scientists have five possibilities for how the universe is going to end. The end of the universe is probably not something we will have to think about in our lifetimes, by which I of course mean the life of the human species , at least you would hope so anyway. But that hasn't stopped science with trying to come up with plenty of theories as to how things may play out in the extremely distant future. Most of us have heard of the Big Bang, the moment when the universe erupted into existence.

items.title_zh: 犯罪现场清洁工透露他仅靠一份工作赚取的收入令人眼花缭乱
items.title_en: Crime scene cleaner reveals eye-watering amount he earned from a single job
items.summary_zh: 警告：本文包含一些读者可能会感到痛苦的主题的讨论。一名清理犯罪现场的男子分享了他只做一份工作就获得的巨额报酬。本·吉尔斯从事的是你能想到的最令人不愉快的工作之一——生物危害清洁工。我们中的许多人可能会让我们的房子变得有点闲置，盘子堆在水槽里，垃圾需要倒掉——这不是本处理的事情。
items.summary_en: Warning: This article contains discussion of topics which some readers may find distressing. A man who cleans crime scenes has shared the enormous amount he was paid for doing just one job. Ben Giles has one of the most unpleasant jobs that you could think of - a biohazard cleaner. Many of us might have let our houses go a little bit, with dishes piling up in the sink, the rubbish needing to be taken out - this is not what Ben deals with.
